name: Spanish Common Words Set 16
description: This set is part of a larger collection of common Spanish words, focusing on frequently used vocabulary not included in previous sets.

cards.sentence: El día de hoy es muy soleado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Today's day is very sunny.

cards.sentence: Buenos días, señor López.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Good morning, Mr. Lopez.

cards.sentence: Debo escoger qué vestido usar para la fiesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I must choose which dress to wear for the party.

cards.sentence: La maestra va a corregir nuestros exámenes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The teacher is going to correct our exams.

cards.sentence: Es importante combatir la pobreza en el mundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's important to fight poverty in the world.

cards.sentence: Tenemos que enfrentar la situación con valentía.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have to face the situation with courage.

cards.sentence: El comité se reúne para evaluar el proyecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The committee meets to evaluate the project.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos aprender a argumentar nuestras ideas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need to learn how to argue our ideas.

cards.sentence: Intentó persuadirme para que fuera a la fiesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He tried to persuade me to go to the party.

cards.sentence: No debemos excluir a nadie del grupo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We should not exclude anyone from the group.

cards.sentence: Espero aprobar el examen de matemáticas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope to pass the math exam.

cards.sentence: Muchas personas sufren de alergias estacionales.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Many people suffer from seasonal allergies.

cards.sentence: Me gusta bañarse en la piscina después del trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to bathe in the pool after work.

cards.sentence: Recuerda cepillar tu cabello antes de dormir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Remember to brush your hair before sleeping.

cards.sentence: Su actitud suele enfadar a la gente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His attitude usually angers people.

cards.sentence: El atleta va a lanzar la jabalina lejos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The athlete is going to throw the javelin far.

cards.sentence: Queremos adoptar un perro de la protectora.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We want to adopt a dog from the shelter.

cards.sentence: Los niños se divierten mucho en el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The children have a lot of fun at the park.

cards.sentence: No podemos culpar a nadie por lo que pasó.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We cannot blame anyone for what happened.

cards.sentence: Debo programar una reunión para la próxima semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I must schedule a meeting for next week.

cards.sentence: Mi trabajo es supervisar el equipo y los proyectos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My job is to supervise the team and the projects.

cards.sentence: Aprender a administrar tu tiempo es clave.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Learning to manage your time is key.

cards.sentence: La campaña busca promover la lectura entre los jóvenes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The campaign seeks to promote reading among young people.

cards.sentence: Es hora de implementar los nuevos cambios.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's time to implement the new changes.

cards.sentence: Esta máquina puede reproducir documentos a color.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This machine can reproduce documents in color.

cards.sentence: La demanda de este producto no deja de aumentar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The demand for this product keeps increasing.

cards.sentence: Espero que la lluvia disminuya pronto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I hope the rain decreases soon.

cards.sentence: Debemos alertar a la policía sobre esta situación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We must alert the police about this situation.

cards.sentence: Te advierto que el camino es peligroso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I warn you that the road is dangerous.

cards.sentence: Vamos a exponer nuestras ideas al público.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to expose our ideas to the public.

cards.sentence: La investigación va a revelar la verdad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The investigation will reveal the truth.

cards.sentence: Me gusta navegar por internet en mi tiempo libre.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to browse the internet in my free time.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos localizar el punto de encuentro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need to locate the meeting point.

cards.sentenceTranslation: You must register before entering the event.

cards.sentence: Puedes almacenar tus archivos en la nube.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can store your files in the cloud.

cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to taste the wines of the region.

cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to toast to your success in the new job.

cards.sentence: La empresa va a promocionar su nuevo producto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The company is going to promote its new product.

cards.sentence: Me parece que es una situación muy injusta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It seems to me that it is a very unfair situation.

cards.sentenceTranslation: With a lot of effort, we managed to finish the project.

cards.sentenceTranslation: My criterion for choosing is quality.

cards.sentenceTranslation: We need a new approach to solve this problem.

cards.sentence: Intenta ver la situación desde otra perspectiva.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Try to see the situation from another perspective.

cards.sentence: El equipo ha hecho un gran progreso este mes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The team has made great progress this month.

cards.sentence: Siempre busco la mejora continua en mi trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I always look for continuous improvement in my work.

cards.sentence: La necesidad de agua potable es fundamental.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The need for drinking water is fundamental.

cards.sentence: Envía un texto si llegas tarde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Send a text if you're late.

cards.sentence: Me gusta leer un cuento antes de dormir.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to read a story before sleeping.

cards.sentence: Este poema expresa un sentimiento profundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This poem expresses a deep feeling.

cards.sentence: El primer verso del poema es muy emotivo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The first verse of the poem is very emotional.

cards.sentence: Cada estrofa de la canción tiene un ritmo diferente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Each stanza of the song has a different rhythm.

cards.sentence: Las palabras 'casa' y 'masa' hacen buena rima.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The words 'casa' and 'masa' make a good rhyme.

cards.sentence: La lectura es una actividad relajante para muchos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Reading is a relaxing activity for many.

cards.sentence: Su escritura es muy clara y fácil de entender.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His writing is very clear and easy to understand.

cards.sentence: El presidente dio un discurso inspirador.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The president gave an inspiring speech.

cards.sentenceTranslation: We had a nice chat about the future.

cards.sentenceTranslation: I got a job interview for Monday.

cards.sentence: El reportaje investigó la corrupción en la ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The report investigated corruption in the city.

cards.sentence: La película recibió una crítica excelente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The movie received an excellent review.

cards.sentence: El debate político fue muy intenso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The political debate was very intense.

cards.sentence: Asistí a una conferencia sobre nuevas tecnologías.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I attended a conference on new technologies.

cards.sentence: Cada año celebramos un festival de música en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Every year we celebrate a music festival in summer.

cards.sentence: Fuimos al concierto de nuestra banda favorita.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We went to our favorite band's concert.

cards.sentence: Hay una nueva exposición de arte en el museo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There is a new art exhibition at the museum.

cards.sentence: La galería de arte está en el centro de la ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The art gallery is in the city center.

cards.sentence: Me gusta tu estilo de vestir, es muy original.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like your dressing style, it's very original.

cards.sentence: La tendencia actual es hacia lo natural.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The current trend is towards natural things.

cards.sentence: La estructura del edificio es muy sólida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The building's structure is very solid.

cards.sentence: Este descubrimiento representa un gran avance científico.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This discovery represents a great scientific advance.

cards.sentence: El vuelo sufrió un retraso de dos horas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The flight experienced a two-hour delay.

cards.sentenceTranslation: We need more data to make an informed decision.

cards.sentence: El atleta entrenó duro para la competición.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The athlete trained hard for the competition.

cards.sentence: El tren estaba lleno de pasajeros.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The train was full of passengers.

cards.sentence: No olvides tu equipaje al bajar del avión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't forget your luggage when getting off the plane.

cards.sentenceTranslation: See you at Terminal 3 of the airport.

cards.sentence: Mi vuelo sale a las siete de la mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My flight departs at seven in the morning.

cards.sentence: El despegue fue suave y sin problemas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The takeoff was smooth and without problems.

cards.sentence: El aterrizaje del avión fue perfecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The plane's landing was perfect.

cards.sentence: Hice una reserva en el restaurante para esta noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I made a reservation at the restaurant for tonight.

cards.sentence: Buscamos alojamiento económico para nuestras vacaciones.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are looking for affordable accommodation for our vacation.

cards.sentence: Se me tensó un músculo en la pierna al correr.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A muscle in my leg tensed up while running.

cards.sentence: El corazón es un órgano vital.

cards.sentenceTranslation: The liver is important for digestion.

cards.sentence: Los riñones filtran la sangre en el cuerpo.

cards.sentence: Ella le dio un beso en la mejilla.

cards.sentence: Se mordió el labio para no reírse.

cards.sentenceTranslation: Check the train schedule for your trip.

cards.sentenceTranslation: I have a full schedule for this week.

cards.sentence: Por favor, ¿me pasas la servilleta?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Please, can you pass me the napkin?
